title: BrainQuake example SEEG data: ictal and interictal stereo-EEG from 8 epilepsy patients (Tsinghua Yuquan Hospital)
description: Stereo-EEG recordings from eight patients with drug-resistant epilepsy, collected during pre-surgical monitoring at the Epilepsy Center of Tsinghua Yuquan Hospital. The dataset contains 71-second ictal clips and interictal segments of up to about 2 hours per patient, sampled at 2000 Hz. It was released as example data for the BrainQuake toolbox, supporting epileptogenicity index and high-frequency event analyses. The data are reorganised into iEEG-BIDS without signal processing.
methods_description: SEEG depth-electrode recordings were acquired at 2000 Hz during about two weeks of pre-surgical monitoring. Ictal clips (71 s) were exported for epileptogenicity index analysis, and interictal segments were exported for high-frequency oscillation detection. Interictal files are discontinuous EDF+D with clinical annotations. Files were converted to BIDS with no signal changes, and patient names in EDF+ annotations were masked.
